data.long_meaning: Deepu is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'deep', meaning 'deep' or 'abysmal'. historical_references.reference: Deepu was a celebrated poet and scholar during the reign of the Vijayanagara Empire (1336-1646) in southern India. He was also known as 'Deepa Varnamrita Deepu' meaning 'Deepu, the ocean of knowledge illumined by Deepa (lamp)'.
Deepu was a prominent Jain monk and philosopher who lived during the 12th century in India. He is known for his work 'Tattvartha Sutra' which is considered a fundamental text in Jain philosophy.
